name: app-red-white-smartwatch-ui-screens-grid
title: Red Smartwatch Screens Grid
whatItIs: A peach sheet with a 4-by-6 grid of white watch faces: clocks, steps, BPM, weather, alarm, payment, music, calculator, contacts, chat and calls, in red, orange and dark navy.
whatItMeans: One rounded card shape and red accents make many functions read as a single family.
techniques: Red as the primary action colour

vocabulary.definition: The main screen of a smartwatch.
A grid showing many screens or components.
